newsitem.title: THAILAND: Stuntman claims record in Thailand motorcycle jump.
newsitem.headline: Stuntman claims record in Thailand motorcycle jump.

text.p: Hollywood stuntman Matthew Coulter has claimed a world record in a four-wheeled motorcycle jump over 20 motorised tricycle taxis in Thailand.
"I feel great, fantastic," the 26-year-old Australian stuntman said after jumping 20 of the taxis, or tuk tuks as they are known locally, lined up on a soccer field in Bangkok late on Sunday.

Coulter, who has performed stunts in James Bond movies, said his 152-ft (46.5-metre) jump set a new world record, beating his own longest jump in England in 1994 when he jumped a four-wheeled motorcycle over a row of cars stretching 144 feet (43.9 metres).
"I am thinking of setting another new record soon, maybe next year when I come to Thailand again to jump over the River Kwai," Matthew told Reuters.
The river, flowing from western Thailand into Burma, was the scene of the movie "The Bridge on the River Kwai" in the early 1960s.
